New Relic is looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager – GTM Business Planning to own the operating system behind how we plan, pay, and scale our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization.   • Annual Planning Execution: Demonstrated success leading annual GTM planning cycles end-to-end (capacity modeling, territory carving, quota setting, and Salesforce deployment).
  • Analytics & Technical Proficiency: Advanced expertise in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets), business intelligence platforms (Looker, Tableau), and Salesforce architecture (flow automation, custom objects, and schemas).
